title: The Iron Cipher
tagline: An encrypted transmitter. A silent alleyway. A coded frequency.
atmosphere: Dusk over brick alleyways, distant traffic drone, chill air.
premise: A rogue broadcast node was detected intermittently pinging pirate frequencies from an urban commercial alleyway. The relay was concealed inside everyday city infrastructure.

suspects.name: Darius Thorne
suspects.motive: Selling unauthorized pirate mesh network bandwidth to black-market traders.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was logging transformer voltages 3 blocks north all evening.
suspects.hiddenTrait: Secures all personal splices with military-grade black vulcanized heat-shrink tubing.
suspects.eliminationClue: None — his distinct black heat-shrink tubing is found anchoring the transmitter.

suspects.name: Mara Lin
suspects.motive: Protesting telecom infrastructure monopoly by building pirate repeater towers.
suspects.alibi: Was on a live video conference with municipal zoning until 19:00.
suspects.hiddenTrait: Always labels splice junctions with numbered blue metallic foil tape.
suspects.eliminationClue: Beat 2 proves the node used vulcanized rubber seal, not Mara's blue foil tape.

suspects.name: Victor Rossi
suspects.motive: Hired to tap building power feeds to run underground crypto mining rigs.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was replacing fan bearings in the basement boiler room.
traits: Galvanized sheet metal screws in pocket
suspects.hiddenTrait: Uses distinct silver mastic foil on all duct and wiring penetrations.
suspects.eliminationClue: Beat 4 confirms high-frequency RF wiring spliced directly into high-voltage conduit, beyond Victor's standard low-voltage HVAC skills.

beats.title: The Masonry Junction
beats.prompt: Locate an exposed brick, stone, or textured masonry wall in your vicinity.
beats.fieldInstruction: Pocket your device. Walk down your street or walkway until you find a textured masonry wall.

targetPredicate.name: Textured Masonry Surface
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Look for brickwork or layered concrete blocks along the street edge.
hintLevels.level2: Find a vertical wall where the texture of stone or mortar is clearly visible.
hintLevels.level3: Inspect the lower half of an exterior brick or cinderblock facade.

beats.narrativeRevelation: A fresh conduit bracket was drilled directly into the mortar line, drawing unauthorized current from the street line.

beats.title: The Weathered Seal
beats.prompt: Locate a dark, weathered seal, joint, or dark rubber/metal seam.
beats.fieldInstruction: Phone away. Look around utility conduits, drainpipes, or meter enclosures for dark weatherproofing.

targetPredicate.name: Vulcanized Weatherproof Seal
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Search for dark rubberized or oxidized joints around outdoor utility pipes.
hintLevels.level2: Look for black heat-shrink or weather-proof seals on metal conduit.
hintLevels.level3: Check where a vertical pipe meets a wall bracket or utility housing.

beats.narrativeRevelation: The waterproof seal on the junction is military-spec vulcanized rubber, standard issue only for Substation Electricians. Fiber splicer Mara Lin is ruled out.

beats.title: The Warning Signage
beats.prompt: Locate a public metal sign, street sign, warning marker, or typographic emblem.
beats.fieldInstruction: Pocket your phone. Walk 50 meters and locate an outdoor metal plate or signpost.

targetPredicate.name: Public Metal Sign / Marker
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Scan for street name plates, parking signs, or municipal warning markers.
hintLevels.level2: Look for high-contrast letters stamped on a painted metal plate.
hintLevels.level3: Inspect the eye-level plate on a nearby pole or public utility box.

beats.narrativeRevelation: Affixed behind the metal sign is a micro magnetic coil antenna broadcasting pirate RF signals across the district.

beats.title: The Hardware Fastener
beats.prompt: Locate a circular metal bolt, locking latch, or industrial hinge.
beats.fieldInstruction: Final step. Phone away and inspect utility access fixtures for an engineered circular fastener.

targetPredicate.name: Industrial Locking Fastener
targetPredicate.safetyNotice: Only observe objects in open, public, accessible areas. Never trespass.

hintLevels.level1: Look at the locking mechanism of a public fixture or metal access hatch.
hintLevels.level2: Search for heavy steel bolt heads holding a metal enclosure in place.
hintLevels.level3: Inspect the hinge or latch on a utility box along the wall.

beats.narrativeRevelation: The enclosure is secured with a high-voltage utility lock key that only certified substation staff possess. Victor Rossi lacks the clearances and keys.

solutionNarrative: Darius Thorne tapped the municipal line using certified high-voltage gear and installed the pirate transmitter behind the sign using vulcanized rubber seals. His electrician credentials gave him sole access to the keyed utility lock.
audioNarrationSummary: Darius Thorne turned the public electrical grid into his personal pirate relay. The vulcanized sealant and high-voltage lock conclusively identify him as the culprit.
